free_tier.stated: No free tier. The 1 GB KVM VPS special is USD 21.99 a year: 1 vCPU, 20 GB SSD, 1 GB RAM, 3 TB monthly transfer, 1Gbps network port, 1 IPv4 address, full root, deployable in multiple locations. The ladder goes to USD 35.99 (2 GB, 5 TB), USD 59.99 (4 GB, 7 TB), USD 89.99 (6 GB, 12 TB) and USD 119.99 (8 GB, 20 TB) a year.

interface_detail: KVM guest with full root; the ctrl panel gives reboot, reinstall, console, firewall and one-click apps.

binding_note: 3 TB/month is the ceiling on the cheapest plan; a 1Gbps port can move that allowance in hours, so the allowance fails first.
